description: Architecture milestone benchmark matrix. Comparison rows are equivalent real builds on both sides. Failing rows are required comparisons that are not implemented yet.

phases.title: Dynamic derivation primitive probes
phases.notes: Runs committed Nix primitive probes, including feature flags, builtins.outputOf availability, and nix derivation show/add round-trips for penance and haskell.nix benchmark derivations.

phases.title: Commit-time lock generation
phases.notes: Measures one repent solver run that byte-checks and writes the committed benchmark lock against one real haskell.nix generated plan output. The broader deterministic, stale-lock, Hackage sdist, and ghc-boot proof remains enforced by checks.repent-lock-proof.

phases.title: Static unit path on simple library fixture
phases.notes: The penance target is the lock-built simple-lib component from penanceProject: Nix reads schema-1 penance.lock, builds a content-addressed library with a GHC-Wasm-canonicalized real interface output plus real objects/archive, and compares it with the haskell.nix simple library build.

phases.title: Static unit path on module-heavy benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target is the lock-built benchmark executable from penanceProject: Nix reads schema-1 penance.lock, compiles the executable against dbIface, links it against dbFull, and smoke-tests the generated output, compared with the haskell.nix executable build.

phases.title: Module-granular path on Template Haskell benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target runs a content-addressed recursive-Nix planner that emits real per-module object derivations, GHC-Wasm interface-canonicalizer derivations, and a final assemble derivation. Exact rebuild-cutoff assertions are tracked by the M4 rebuild-scenarios rows.

phases.title: First-class Backpack instantiation graph
phases.notes: Real Cabal Backpack fixture with one indefinite library, two implementation libraries, and two executable instantiations compared with the haskell.nix executable build.

phases.title: Haskell aarch64-linux target build
phases.notes: Compiles the same Haskell executable for aarch64-linux with the same cross GHC: penance invokes the compiler directly, while the haskell.nix baseline uses projectCross and Cabal Setup machinery. Both outputs are checked as real aarch64 ELF executables.

phases.title: Multi-System Closure bundle
phases.notes: Creates closureInfo-backed bundle artifacts and manifests for the penance and haskell.nix benchmark executable closures.

phases.title: Device deploy and hot-swap loop
phases.notes: Writes each benchmark executable closure manifest into a device-cache directory and atomically exposes the managed service executable through a run-directory hot-swap symlink.
